newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-ZENIT UPSET SPARTAK IN RUSSIAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZENIT UPSET SPARTAK IN RUSSIAN CUP.

text.p: A goal by defender Konstantin Lepekhin 11 minutes from time gave Zenit St Petersburg an upset 1-0 away victory over league champions Spartak Moscow in the quarter-finals of the Russian Cup on Wednesday.
Lepekhin's shot from the edge of the penalty area caught Spartak goalkeeper Alexander Filimonov by surprise and proved decisive in the second match between the two teams in just four days.
They drew 0-0 in the league in St Petersburg on Saturday and Spartak, who have injury problems, have now gone three matches without scoring.
In the semifinals later this month Zenit will meet another Moscow side, Dynamo, who beat first division Zarya Leninsk Kuznetsky 2-0 on Tuesday. The other semifinal places are still to be decided.
